function f(this: { x: number }) {
  return this.x;
}
type H = { x: number; f: typeof f };

function nullableLink(o: { a: H | undefined } | undefined) {
  console.log(o?.a.f());
}
function parenthesized(o: { a: H } | undefined) {
  console.log((o?.a).f());
}

function assertThenCall(o: { a: H } | undefined): number {
  return o?.a.f!();
}
function assertThenRead(o: { a: H } | undefined): number {
  return o?.a!.x;
}
